1742-1978-3363-3488.notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has a burden counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
1742-1978-3363-3488.description:
Animate The One Ring using Katsumasa.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat from step 2.

4499-6823-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

628-3899-6487.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
An opponent controls seven or more creatures.
628-3899-6487.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Canker Abomination.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, resolve the Spawning Pit ability, and repeat from step 1.
Cast Canker Abomination by paying {2}{B/G}{B/G}.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
Canker Abomination dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2829-5131-7913--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2829-5131-7913--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Iron Lad.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

1594-3188-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Social Climber trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-3188-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1251-3259-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2104-2556-7631.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

423-1437-2895-5621.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-2895-5621.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Uro spell three times.
Resolve the first Uro copy.
The Uro token enters the battlefield, triggering both of its abilities.
Resolve the first Uro ability, sacrificing it. 
Resolve the other Uro ability, gaining 3 life, drawing a card, and putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
Arid Archway enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

1477-4907-6747-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1477-4907-6747-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

2921-4446-5170-6132.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2921-4446-5170-6132.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3007-3899-4552-6705.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
539-3007-3899-4552-6705.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Toymaker.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

328-5220-6798-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-5220-6798-6900.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1642-6109.notablePrerequisites: You control a Gorgon and/or Snake that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent
1642-6109.description:
Activate Aphelia by paying {4}{B}, causing an opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up, whenever they are dealt combat damage by a Gorgon or Snake this turn.
Deal combat damage to the opponent using a Gorgon and/or Snake.
Aphelia triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

628-4050-6863--133.notablePrerequisites: Blue has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-4050-6863--133.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the other Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to the -1/-1 counter it will gain from Blue.
Repeat.
628-4050-6863--133.notes: The chosen Dinosaur must not be a Human for the combo to work. Notably, this means you cannot use a creature with changeling for this combo.

222-527-3967-4927.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3967-4927.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

678-4826-5256-6644.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1020-1976-3689-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2131-5435-5660.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature or artifact card in your graveyard.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
2131-5435-5660.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning an artifact or creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Thran Vigil triggers. Holding priority, activate Dream Trawler by discarding an artifact or creature card.
Resolve the Thran Vigil ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Repeat from step 2.

804-4050-5756.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor, adding one mana of any color.
When Sakashima the Impostor dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

232-2713-4790-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Dino DNA.
232-2713-4790-5149.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {2}, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

413-643-1447.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Angel of Glory's Rise, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, then returning all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Angel of Glory's Rise triggers, and Blasting Station triggers once for each creature returned this way.
Resolve all Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat from step 4.

1357-1636-4115.notablePrerequisites:
Any creature in hand that does not share a creature type with a creature you control or in your graveyard.
You control creatures that can tap to add at least {1}{U}.
Enough mana available to cast the creature spell.
1357-1636-4115.description:
Cast a creature spell by paying its mana cost.
Volo triggers, copying that spell.
Tap creatures to add at least {1}{U}.
Pay {1}{U} and tap Errant to activate her, copying the copied creature spell.
Let one copy of the creature spell resolve.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3.
